about: Pages hidden from the nav, the in-place card swap and the second brain chart. The files stay; delete a line to republish. 'path' is relative to the site root; 'into' is a site-root path or an https link; 'label' names it in the notice. A retired page shows a one-line notice and every link to it is sent to 'into'. Read by ai-life-os/nav.js, ai-life-os/hud.js and ai-life-os/brain/build_data.py (which also writes robots.txt).
